description: Ministry of Sports - Amendment for the National Associations of Sports Regulations No. 01 of 2016
categorisation: This gazette content contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973, which involves legal/regulatory matters. It specifically amends previous regulations and establishes procedures for appeals related to National Sports Associations, falling under the category of regulatory frameworks and legal amendments. While it mentions a minister's name, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would qualify it for Types 1-3.
